title: Quarterly activation plan for private/VPC: tranche gating, OKR mapping, and cross-team pacing
creator: Ava Patel
description: Plan and sequence a tranche-based quarterly activation for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features. Deliver an OKR-aligned rollout cadence, gated compatibility checks, and a cross-team pacing plan that reduces upgrade blast radius while meeting Q2 activation targets. Work includes mapping customer cohorts to activation lanes, defining compatibility gates (runtime, KMS, network topology), documenting rollback and runbook requirements, and coordinating capacity commitments with Dedicated/Infra teams.
acceptance_criteria: Activation lanes defined and prioritized with clear cohort membership and success metrics
Compatibility gate checklist (runtime version, quantization profile, KMS integration, audit log retention) signed off by Eng and Security
Release calendar with sprint-level milestones published to stakeholders and Console/Support teams
Runbooks and rollback playbooks stored in Confluence with runbook owners assigned
Dependencies (ENG, infra, and legal) identified with committed owners and dates
milestones: 2026-02-22: Draft activation lanes and cohort segmentation completed
2026-03-01: Compatibility gate checklist v0.1 - ENG review

risks: KMS/HSM roll-forward incompatibility could block tier-1 customers
Dedicated capacity shortfalls if autoscaling policy not adjusted for burst windows
Undetected model variance after quantization changes leading to quality regressions
OSS dependency upgrade (cuda/cuDNN) in runtime could require hotfixes during tranche activation
